item.description: CNAs — Call for Topics for “CVE Program Fall Technical Workshop: Advancing CVE Record Quality” on October 29, 2026blogBy CVE Program|September 9, 2026The CVE Program will host a “CVE Program Fall Technical Workshop: Advancing CVE Record Quality” virtual event forCVE Numbering Authorities (CNAs)on Thursday, October 29, 2026, from 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM EDT (UTC-4).This CNA workshop is free, but registration is required. item.title: RedEye Security Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)
item.description: RedEye Security Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)newsSeptember 15, 2026RedEye Securityis now aCVE Numbering Authority (CNA)for vulnerabilities in RedEye Security’s own products: software that RedEye develops and distributes for customers to deploy and operate in their own environments. Caver, RedEye’s self-hosted, Splunk-compatible SIEM and OCSF data-lake platform, including its server components, collectors and agents, command-line tooling, and officially distributed installers and container images. Out of scope: vulnerabilities in third-party components and dependencies that RedEye redistributes but does not maintain; vulnerabilities in RedEye-operated hosted services and web properties that RedEye remediates server-side with no customer action required; and the content of RedEye’s threat-intelligence and CVE detection feeds.

item.title: CVE Podcast — CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) Scopes
item.description: CVE Podcast — CVE Numbering Authority (CNA) ScopespodcastSeptember 22, 2026In this episode of the “We Speak CVE” podcast, podcast host Shannon Sabens chats with Alicia Mink of theMITRE Top-Level Rootand Julia Turkevich of theCISA Top-Level RootaboutCVE Numbering Authority (CNA)scopes.Within the CVE Program, the term “scope” refers to the set of products, projects, services, organizations, constituencies, or cases for which a CNA is authorized to assignCVE IDsand publishCVE Records. A well-written CNA scope sets expectations, helps manage workload, improves coordination across the CVE ecosystem, and gives vulnerability reporters a clearer path to the right authority.

item.title: Chainguard Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)
item.description: Chainguard Added as CVE Numbering Authority (CNA)newsSeptember 22, 2026Chainguard, Inc.is now aCVE Numbering Authority (CNA)for Chainguard Containers/Libraries/VMs, tooling, and vulnerabilities introduced by our packaging or patching of Wolfi packages (upstream flaws in packaged software excluded). Additionally, vulnerabilities in open source projects identified through the Athena coalition, where upstream has remediated without an assigned identifier, or where no maintainer is active, and no more specific CNA covers the project.
